name: MengTo/Skills
title: Agent Skills - 设计者与构建者的AI技能库
description: 75个可移植agent技能，面向Codex、Claude Code、Cursor、Aura Build、Lovable等AI编码agent的UI/前端/自动化工作流。包含视频转超级提示、HTML转交互提示、全页面截图、UI灵感收集、设计优先提示系统、CSS动画、WebGL效果等。
coreFeatures: 视频转超级提示工作流 (Video → Super Prompt → HTML)
UI灵感bundles + 截图 + 提示包
设计优先UI提示系统 (6层模板)

codex_workflows.description: 操作性技能，专注Codex agent的重复工作：审计、邮件、客户支持、性能分析、视频分析等

media.description: 图像资源获取：aura-assets设计/营销图库、unsplash高质量图片筛选

ui.description: 设计优先UI提示系统：6层模板(goal→format→layout→type→color→constraints)、variants>rerolls工作流、2-pass字体排版

web_design.description: Web设计技能：落地页、定价页、动画系统、GSAP、Three.js、WebGL、Canvas、CSS处理、布局系统、视觉风格

prompts_are_assets.quote: If it's good once, it should be reusable.

specs_beat_vibes.quote: The fastest way to consistent output is clear constraints and hierarchy.

references_beat_paragraphs.quote: Screenshots and examples carry more than text descriptions.

skills_are_operating_procedures.quote: Good skills tell the agent exactly when to use them, what to do first, what defaults to apply.

claude_code.method: 从 CLAUDE.md 引用；复制到Claude skills setup；直接打开SKILL.md作为工作上下文

cursor.method: Cursor rules 或 chat context 指向skill文件夹；保持可复用片段可粘贴

other_agents.method: 读取最匹配的skill → 按步骤和引用执行

writingStyle: 模仿 Meng To: 可扫读、实用、自信

flagshipWorkflow.name: Video to Super Prompt
flagshipWorkflow.description: Turns a screen recording of a design, landing page, or animation into a super detailed prompt that Fable 5 can use to one-shot HTML.

flagshipWorkflow.name: HTML to Interaction Prompts
flagshipWorkflow.description: Turns an existing HTML page into reusable prompts for one section, one animation, one button, one hover state, or one WebGL effect.

flagshipWorkflow.name: Stitched Full Page Capture
flagshipWorkflow.description: Captures the entire landing page instead of only the hero, giving your agent a full-page reference for structure, pacing, and visual hierarchy.

flagshipWorkflow.name: Daily UI Inspiration
flagshipWorkflow.description: Combines browsing, capture, reference study, and prompt generation into a useful agent loop that turns strong landing pages into detailed prompt packs.
